program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # input pair L
    "Itail": (2.8e-6, 1.5e-6, 3.5e-6),
    "gmidl": (11.0, 7.0, 14.0),      # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "Ll":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmid7": (15.0, 10.0, 16.0),     # 2nd stage PMOS gm/Id
    "L7":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "I7":    (6.0e-6, 4e-6, 7e-6),
    "gmidn": (11.0, 8.0, 13.0),      # NMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Ln":    (2.5, 1.5, 4.0),        # NMOS current-source L (long -> avoid min-W clamp)
    "Cc":    (1.8e-12, 1.0e-12, 4e-12),
    "kz":    (2.5, 1.0, 5.0),        # Rz = kz/gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 1e-6)
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    gmidn = p["gmidn"]

    # NMOS bias mirrors (all from ibias diode), same L and gm/Id -> W ratio = current ratio
    mref = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.65)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.25)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)
    # input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.55, vsb=0.25)
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidl"], p["Ll"], It / 2, vds=0.95)
    # second stage
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], I7, vds=0.9)
    Rz = p["kz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # vinp -> n1 side (non-inverting overall through inverting PMOS CS)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    C2 = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (C1 * C2 + Cc * (C1 + C2)) / (2 * PI)
    dz = Rz - 1.0 / m7.gm
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * dz) if dz > 0 else -1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * abs(dz) + 1e-30)
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pm_mirror = m3.gm / (2 * m3.cgg) / (2 * PI)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pm_mirror)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I7)
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power, "slew": slew}

events.topology: Two-stage Miller (NMOS-input 5T first stage, PMOS CS second stage, Rz-Cc compensation)

events.reason: Bias mirrors don't copy ibias: MREF appears width-clamped (gm/Id 12.8 vs 9), so M5/M8 carry ~40% of intended current, starving gm1 and UGBW. Use longer, higher-gm/Id mirror devices to escape the clamp
